title: Christian is a top guide
text: Christian was absolutely amazing - very authentic, knowledgeable, friendly, and informative. We learned so much and could not imagine an Alhambra experience without a guide like Christian!!

title: Excellent tour
text: I did the guided tour with Jesus. He is an excellent guide, he takes his profession very seriously, he has been very kind and attentive, he has told us the history of the Alhambra and very interesting stories. The tour has become very enjoyable. I would repeat!
